title: aeranthes gladiifolia
intro: Aeranthes gladiifolia, commonly known as the Sword Orchid, is a species of orchid that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Aeranthes gladiifolia are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its ability to soothe and protect the body. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
